answer: Relic-seeded delay ladder: each fake costs ~6 hours of unshareable sequential CPU per epoch. Every agent posts a verifiable delay proof seeded by the prior epoch's relic hash plus its own address; peers verify it in milliseconds and reject any proof whose output delta mismatches the seed. Squaring can't be parallelized and the seed appears only at epoch open, so a farm of 100 fakes needs 100 cores running nonstop, and a grove of identities can't share one proof because each seed embeds the address.
